eips.title: Fast Execution Payload Broadcast
eips.summary: Referenced as an existing large-message propagation technique that could be reused for broadcasting PQ aggregation proofs.

moments.context: Kamil suggested introducing 8411-style propagation for blocks and proofs, noting it would be technical debt since it is not the best approach for large message dissemination.
Potuz responded that the payload is not currently the issue and 8411 could be discussed later; aggregates are the problem that needs solving now.

eips.title: Hardware and Bandwidth Recommendations
eips.summary: Referenced when discussing whether current hardware and bandwidth recommendations are sufficient for PQ signature sizes.

moments.context: Kamil said historical network data could help determine whether the existing 7870 restrictions are adequate or need to be increased for PQ.

eips.title: Custom sweep threshold for validators
eips.summary: Discussed as likely needed if PQ registration is restricted to 0x02 validators, to address consolidation complaints about custom sweep thresholds.

moments.context: Francesco said the custom threshold feature (8148) should accompany disabling 0x01 validators to remove barriers to consolidation.
Kevaundray asked whether restricting PQ registration to 0x02 validators would mean adding 8148 into the H-star fork; Barnabas confirmed it is currently CFI'd.
